# Publisher-owned branch force policy

If config.push is true, the publisher will push to the configured remote; when a new commit is created the push is performed with --force, and when the tree is identical the push (if any) is performed without --force.

Allow the publisher to resolve divergence in favor of the published snapshot while avoiding unnecessary forced updates when nothing changed.
